ledgerSearch.outcome: The semantic review records that the baseline envoi required the reader to feel widening, remember a future event, find destined people, and accept pleasure as the right path, and that the pass offered recognition as one possible experience, identified the future memory as speculation, and left practice to choice. CTD-0091's evidence quotes this envoi directly. CTD-0076 forbids icons for individual communities, which the baseline uses here. Every one of those corrections is kept. The prose, the anamnesis passage, the nervous system argument, the homecoming, and the closing are restored around them.

findings.summary: The nesting that assembles as a reader reads was replaced by a description of the book.

evidence.baseline: a small intelligence nested inside a larger one, and that inside a larger one still, until the nesting runs past the edge of the page and out into the world.
evidence.shipped: The book has assembled one idea inside another until the nesting passes beyond the page.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.16, performed intimacy, applied to Something has been assembling itself in you.
findings.diagnosis: The autonomy correction belongs to the certainty and is kept: something may have been assembling itself, and a reader may have felt nothing of the kind. The image itself assigns nothing, and running past the edge of the page and out into the world is the volume's last statement of what a nest does.

findings.summary: The anamnesis passage lost Socrates and the returning recognition.

evidence.baseline: Socrates spent his life drawing such rememberings out of people who swore they knew nothing. ... not information arriving, but a recognition returning, the remembering of something the human being has always carried and only lately set down.
evidence.shipped: Socratic questioning is often read as drawing such recollection into view. ... an idea may sometimes arrive with the feeling of recognition rather than novelty.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the recorded correction identifying anamnesis as a historical concept rather than proof of the reader's experience.
findings.diagnosis: The correction is met by saying that the claim belongs to one tradition rather than to every reader, which is kept. People who swore they knew nothing is the detail that makes Socrates a person rather than a method, and only lately set down is the envoi's account of what the whole series is trying to recover.

findings.summary: The remembering of a future turn toward worship was replaced with a paraphrase of itself.

evidence.baseline: Picture the moment, which wears the clothing of the future though the soul keeps stranger time than the clock, when we turned, as a species, back toward worship. Back toward the body of worship we might yet be: reverent, attentive, in love with the life we are made of.
evidence.shipped: The envoi imagines a future in which the species turns again toward reverence, attention, and love for the life of which it is made.

findings.authorizedBy: The recorded correction removing the required memory.
findings.diagnosis: The correction concerns whether the reader is told to remember, and it is met by converting Can you recall into an invitation to picture and by stating that this is a speculation offered rather than a memory anyone is asked to have. The soul keeps stranger time than the clock is the envoi's own register, and the shipped sentence describes the envoi from outside it.

evidence.baseline: It can be a homecoming, and homecomings are sweet. ... and we had only forgotten, and the forgetting was much of the wound.
evidence.shipped: That possibility does not prove that ethical action is always pleasurable or without sacrifice. It suggests that responsibility and aliveness need not be enemies.

findings.authorizedBy: The recorded correction removing pleasure as the right path.
findings.diagnosis: The correction is met by declining to promise that responsibility is costless, which is kept as its own sentence. Homecomings are sweet and the forgetting was much of the wound are the envoi's two warmest beats and the card records reverence as an offered register in this volume. The shipped version keeps the caveat and deletes what it was qualifying.

debtImpact.note: Something has been assembling itself in you becomes may have been, with an added sentence allowing that a reader may have felt nothing of the kind. Can you recall the moment becomes an invitation to picture it, followed by a statement that this is a speculation offered rather than a memory anyone is asked to have. The right way to live turns out to be the most pleasurable becomes may turn out, with the refusal to promise that responsibility is costless kept. That you go and find the others becomes that some readers do.
The baseline calls the communities the icons twice. Both are corrected: each is a Scale, and the closing hope names their Scale rather than their icons.
The claim that our technologies are extensions of the central nervous system is restored with the pass's qualification that the analogy has limits.
The anamnesis and worship material draws on traditions whose lineage the item tracks. It is restored with its status stated and the item stays open.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Six em dashes, four of them paired around appositives. Two became commas, two paired sets were rebuilt into commas around the parenthetical, one became a colon before the nervous system claim, and the closing dash before go became a comma.
R-LEDGER-WINS across three items. Every autonomy correction is kept and each is stated as its own sentence rather than as a hedge inside a restored one.

The protected line The dragon is not elsewhere, waiting. It is the name this book gives awareness when it becomes answerable to the life around it is present verbatim. It is the pass's wording; the baseline reads The dragon was never somewhere else, waiting. The baseline's It always was is restored after it.

The nesting that runs past the page, the two questions about how it feels, Socrates and the people who swore they knew nothing, the recognition returning, the turn toward worship, the older technology of presence, the nervous system extended recklessly across the world, the tools that settle rather than fray, the homecoming and the wound, and the two hopes held in two hands.

openQuestions: The closing line. The baseline reads And now, go, dear Earth awakening, anywhere that coherence takes you. The vocative names the reader as the Earth awakening, which is the assigned identity CTD-0091 records the pass as removing and which the corpus card forbids without an author ruling. It is rendered as And now, go anywhere that coherence takes you. This is the most consequential wording judgment in Volume VI and it is the author's to settle. The baseline text is quoted here in full so it can be restored in one edit.

The envoi is now 9 percent longer than the baseline. The increase is the autonomy language, stated as sentences rather than as hedges so the surrounding prose could keep its rhythm. In the volume's most compressed register that is a visible cost.

The protected closing line is the pass's, not the baseline's. Of the volume's five protected lines, four were authored by the compressed pass and only A blueprint is not a prophecy exists in the source.

Voice card exemplar anchors. The Volume VI card lists opening anchors drawn from the compressed pass rather than from the baseline, so a faithful re-render displaces some of them. Four of the card's five protected lines were also authored by the pass and do not exist in the baseline at all; all four are kept verbatim. The card needs re-preparation against the re-rendered source, and that is a card revision the author should authorise.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus card, the volume-06 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required, and the envoi is where tonight's restore-and-flag policy and the binding cards collide hardest, as it did in Volume V's epilogue. The resolution was the same and it generalises: separate the assignment from the invitation. Telling a reader they have remembered, that they will find destined people, and that they are the Earth awakening are assignments the cards forbid. Picturing a future together, naming the practice, and blessing the going are invitations the cards license, and the pass removed both classes at once.
